text: The future of artificial intelligence is both exciting and uncertain. Today we have "narrow AI", which is good at specific tasks like translation or driving. Many experts are now working on general AI, also called AGI, which could think and learn like a human. Supporters believe AGI could solve major problems such as disease and climate change. However, critics warn about serious risks, including job losses and safety issues. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely: some say in ten years, while others think it is still decades away. Most agree that we need careful rules to make sure AI benefits everyone.
